prompt.title: Being Gentle With Yourself
prompt.question: What is something you struggled with today that you can forgive yourself for?

prompt.title: One Brave Interaction
prompt.question: What is one small conversation or social moment you handled recently?

prompt.title: Simplifying the Day

prompt.title: Noticing the Little Things
